title: Sintel
description: A lonely young woman named Sintel searches the world for the baby dragon she once rescued and raised, facing a far darker truth at the end of her journey.

title: Tears of Steel
description: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a group of scientists and warriors attempt to rescue the world by revisiting a painful breakup from the past.

title: Big Buck Bunny
description: A giant, gentle rabbit is pushed too far by three bullying rodents and sets out on a hilarious, elaborate plan for revenge.

title: Elephants Dream
description: Two strange characters explore a surreal, ever-shifting machine world — the very first open movie made entirely with open-source software.

title: Cosmos Laundromat
description: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime.

title: Nosferatu
description: F. W. Murnau's expressionist masterpiece: estate agent Hutter travels to Transylvania and unwittingly unleashes the vampire Count Orlok on his hometown.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: George A. Romero's landmark horror film: strangers barricade themselves in a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise to attack the living.

title: Carnival of Souls
description: After surviving a car accident, a church organist is drawn to an abandoned lakeside pavilion and haunted by a ghoulish figure only she can see.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: Vincent Price stars as an eccentric millionaire who offers five guests $10,000 each to survive one night in a haunted mansion.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A klutzy florist's assistant cultivates a strange plant with an appetite for human blood in Roger Corman's cult black comedy.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
description: A sinister hypnotist uses a somnambulist to commit murders in this defining work of German Expressionist cinema.

title: His Girl Friday
description: Cary Grant and Rosalind Russell trade rapid-fire wisecracks as a newspaper editor schemes to win back his ex-wife and star reporter.

title: The General
description: Buster Keaton plays a Southern train engineer who single-handedly pursues Union spies who have stolen his beloved locomotive.

title: Sherlock Jr.
description: A movie projectionist who dreams of being a detective walks right into the film he is screening in Buster Keaton's inventive comedy.

title: Detour
description: A down-on-his-luck pianist hitchhiking to Los Angeles is pulled into a nightmare of chance, guilt and blackmail in this lean noir classic.

title: D.O.A.
description: Poisoned and with only days to live, an accountant races to find out who murdered him — and why.

title: Kansas City Confidential
description: Framed for an armored-car robbery, an ex-con follows the trail to Mexico to track down the masked gang who set him up.

title: The Hitch-Hiker
description: Two friends on a fishing trip pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a psychopathic killer, in Ida Lupino's taut thriller.

title: Beat the Devil
description: Humphrey Bogart leads a band of oddball swindlers stranded in Italy on their way to grab uranium-rich land in Africa.

title: McLintock!
description: John Wayne stars as a cattle baron whose estranged wife, Maureen O'Hara, returns to town to win custody of their daughter.

title: Metropolis
description: In a futuristic city split between wealthy planners and oppressed workers, the son of the city's ruler falls for a prophet of the underclass.

title: A Trip to the Moon
description: Georges Méliès' pioneering fantasy follows a group of astronomers who blast off in a capsule and land in the eye of the Man in the Moon.

title: The Lost World
description: Professor Challenger leads an expedition to a remote Amazon plateau where dinosaurs still roam, in this stop-motion milestone.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description: Lon Chaney is the disfigured genius who haunts the Paris Opera House and becomes obsessed with a young soprano.

title: Gulliver's Travels
description: Fleischer Studios' animated feature sees shipwrecked Lemuel Gulliver wash ashore in Lilliput, a kingdom on the brink of war.

title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
description: Aliens resurrect the dead to stop humanity from building a doomsday weapon in Ed Wood's gloriously low-budget cult favorite.
